file_metadata.design_target: Physical Floorplanning & I/O Pad Ring Boundary Initialization

die_footprint.notes: Strict low-power medical implant size footprint of 500μm x 500μm (0.5mm x 0.5mm ultra-compact die area).

core_margins_microns.notes: Defines space between internal transistor logic cell gate area and outer pad ring.

core_utilization_calibration.notes: Target density factor of 0.60 (60% cell surface utilization). Allocates 40% empty space for routing congestion lines, multi-voltage domain isolation walls, and level-shifter cell tracks safely.

voltage_ring_guard_bands.notes: Generates explicit physical structural gaps and spacing barriers on the silicon die between the 0.8V Always-On domain and the 1.1V Switchable Math domain to prevent physical power leakage.
